name_en: Chief Minister's Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam 2011 (Farmers Security Scheme)
department: Revenue Administration (Commissioner of Revenue Administration), Government of Tamil Nadu
benefit: Small farmers and farm workers who are members, and their families, can get help money: Rs 1,200 old age pension a month, Rs 1,000 a month during serious illness (TB, cancer, HIV), Rs 1,00,000 for accidental death, Rs 20,000 for natural death, Rs 2,500 for funeral costs, marriage help (Rs 10,000 for women, Rs 8,000 for men), and yearly study help for children.

other: Main member: small or marginal farmer (wet land up to 2.5 acres or dry land up to 5 acres, farming it yourself), farm labourer, inland fishing worker or plantation worker.
Age 18 to 65 to join as main member.
Family members who do not earn (husband or wife, children, parents, dead son's wife and children) can join as dependants.
For the old age pension: age 60 or more, destitute, a farmer or landless farm worker, fixed assets not above Rs 1,00,000, and a CMUPT membership card.

documents: For old age pension: photo, Aadhaar card, age proof, Aadhaar consent form, smart ration card or address proof, CMUPT membership card, self-declaration, ID proof, bank passbook
how_to_apply: For the old age pension: take copies of your papers to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC), give your fingerprint, fill the form, upload the papers and keep the receipt. Applying is free.
where_to_apply: Common Service Centre (CSC) for the old age pension

gaps: How to enrol as a CMUPT member (to get the membership card) is not described on either source; how_to_apply covers only the old age pension.
Documents listed are for the old age pension only; enrolment documents are not stated.

The landreforms.tn.gov.in page has no date; amounts (e.g. natural death Rs 20,000, changed after 23.4.2017) may have been revised since. The old age pension was Rs 1,000 on both of these pages; the official Revenue Administration page shows Rs 1,200 from August 2023, which is used.

The pension page on myScheme says the pension is run by the Social Welfare and Women Empowerment Department; the landreforms page says it is given through the Commissioner of Revenue Administration. Department is set to Revenue Administration (owner of the main scheme page).
Source does not give a helpline number.
